NONE: › to persuade someone to do something they might not want to do, by pleasant talk and (sometimes false) promises

example: He really knows how to cajole people into doing what he wants.
他精於哄騙人們為他做事。
I managed to cajole her out of leaving too early.
我設法說服了她不要過早離開。
The most effective technique is to cajole rather than to threaten.
最有效的方法是勸誘而不是威脅。

NONE: › a person who lives in the US state of Louisiana and whose relations in the past were French-speaking Canadians
卡津人（居住在美國路易斯安那州，為法裔加拿大人的後代）
› belonging to or relating to Cajuns
卡津的；卡津人的；關於卡津（人）的

example: Lafayette is the home of Cajun music/dance.
拉法葉是卡津音樂／舞蹈的發源地。
